title: AHB-to-AXI Bridge Debug
description: Debug burst translation in a buggy AHB-to-AXI bridge: split long AHB INCR bursts at the AXI4 256-transfer limit, check WLAST per AXI burst, and flag AHB stimulus that crosses 1KB.

steps.title: Step 1: Reproduce the Split Bug
steps.instructions: Run `testbench.sv` and inspect the AXI AW log for the `long_incr_bytes` request. The bridge sends a 300-transfer AHB INCR as one AXI burst: AWLEN wraps to 43, but WLAST arrives on transfer 300.

steps.title: Step 2: Complete the Checker
steps.instructions: Open `bridge_split_checker.sv` and implement the AHB 1KB input check, per-burst WLAST accounting, the first split length, and total W transfer accounting.

steps.title: Step 3: Fix the Split Function
steps.instructions: Replace the body of `choose_buggy_burst_beats()` with the 256-transfer cap from `solution.sv`, then rerun the lab.
